## Papers under review

::: {.paper}
### Global Games of Coup d'État: Identification and Estimation
**Matthew J. Baker, Khaled Eltokhy, and Weichao Guo** · 2026

A structural global-games model of coup attempts and success that separates incentives to rebel from regime strength, coordination, and information quality.

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05534)
:::

::: {.paper}
### Demand Estimation with Variable Choice Sets: A Likelihood Correction for Nested Logit
**Matthew J. Baker and Lisa M. George** · 2026

We derive the exact likelihood for the Berry (1994) share-form nested logit when choice sets vary across markets, identify a Jacobian correction that matters for within-nest substitution, and apply the estimator to Medicare Advantage plan proliferation.

[SSRN](https://ssrn.com/abstract=7207938) · [DOI](https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7207938) · [GitHub / exactnl](https://github.com/lisa-george/exactnl)
:::

## Forthcoming publications

::: {.paper}
### A Model of Enclosures: Coordination, Conflict, and Efficiency in the Transformation of Land Property Rights
**Matthew J. Baker and Jonathan Conning** · 2026

*Review of Economic Studies*, forthcoming.

A model of the transformation of common-property regimes in which private enclosure decisions can be strategic complements or substitutes, with implications for coordination, conflict, and efficiency.

[Online appendix and replication materials](https://open-enclose.github.io/)
:::

::: {.paper}
### Cultural Transmission, Property Rights, and Treatment of the Elderly
**Matthew J. Baker and Joyce P. Jacobsen** · 2026

*Journal of Population Economics*, forthcoming.

A model of how property rights, production technologies, and cultural transmission interact to shape the treatment and economic position of the elderly.
:::
